objective: Determine whether projected/recurrent cosine agreement can make a bounded RWKV residual materially depend on the correct row and layer while preserving the vector gate's exact projected-only zero-state identity.

authorization_basis.diagnosis: Elementwise vector modulation improved the material projected carrier but did not make the correction sufficiently row- or layer-specific.
authorization_basis.response: Gate a bounded additive recurrent direction by projected/recurrent cosine agreement so a correction requires content agreement in the destination layer.

architecture.fusion_equation: projected_read + 0.125 * rms(projected_read) * clamp(cos(projected_read, recurrent_read), -1, 1) * tanh(recurrent_read / rms(recurrent_read))
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent read has zero cosine agreement and zero recurrent direction, so fusion is exactly projected-only.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.correct_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct-row recurrent state.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus zero recurrent state.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus a deterministic different-gold, length-matched donor recurrent state.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct recurrence cyclically moved across all 42 wrapped layers.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked eight-update causal training run with a disjoint open-fit endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and do not train this equation.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim only BF16-visible structural sensitivity to correct row and layer under fresh initialization.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later causal training and a separately locked native generation result.
